mechanism: Risedronate may impair sacubitril absorption due to effects on gastric pH and GI motility, while sacubitril's valsartan component may increase renal effects and electrolyte disturbances in the setting of bisphosphonate use.
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes; monitor renal function and electrolytes; ensure adequate hydration and upright position after risedronate dosing.
